description: This is the main Dart source file for a Flutter-based mobile audiobook application. It includes UI components, app state management, data models, and interactions with local storage and a database for managing a library of audiobooks, playback progress, and user actions.

classes.name: Audiobook
classes.description: Represents an audiobook with properties like id, title, author, duration, cover URL, and description.

classes.name: LibraryModel
classes.description: Manages user's audiobook library, playback progress, current audiobook, and persistence with local database and shared preferences.

classes.name: AudiobookApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the theme and initial state of the app.

classes.name: MainTabScreen
classes.description: Main screen with bottom navigation for Store, Library, and Player sections.

classes.name: StoreScreen
classes.description: Displays available audiobooks for purchase, allowing users to buy and add to their library.

classes.name: LibraryScreen
classes.description: Displays purchased audiobooks; allows selecting for playback.

classes.name: PlayerScreen
classes.description: Displays audiobook cover art and playback controls, including progress management, skipping, and switching audiobooks.

methods.name: _formatDuration
methods.description: Converts seconds into a formatted string HH:MM:SS or MM:SS for display.
